systems.owner: Ministère de la Sécurité (project created by joint order of the security and finance ministries, 15 June 2020)
systems.tiers: Not stated; described as a digitised mechanism for pooling and sharing information among internal-security actors, with five modules deployed: the IRAPOL core, Police judiciaire, management of detainees and remand prisons, tracking of civilian arms, and the mobile version IRAPOL SMART

note: No fact: the communique (Council of Ministers, 5 February 2026) describes IRAPOL only as pooling and sharing information among internal-security actors and does not say that stations or brigades enter reports or cases in it, so it is not a record-class system on this document's words. It states the project 'has not reached the expected results' and is to be reformed as a development operation costed at FCFA 10 billion over 24 months, fiche approved 2026-02-05. Class is the drafter's reading of 'mutualisation et partage'; the Police judiciaire module is named but not described. Capture is an excerpt, truncated in the nominations section.
